podcast.title: Early Talent Show Group
podcast.body: The Royals were part of a loose association of musicians and singers, including Jackie Wilson and Little Willie John, who performed regularly at talent contests around Detroit. "He was part of a loose association of musicians and singers, including Wilson's cousin Levi Stubbs, the royals who would later become Hank Ballard and the Midnighters, and the blue singer Little Willie John."

podcast.title: Recorded Otis's Song for Wilson
podcast.body: As a result of King Records not signing Jackie Wilson, a song that Johnny Otis had written specifically for Wilson was instead recorded by The Royals. "As a result, a song that Otis had written for Wilson was recorded instead by the royals."

podcast.title: Signed by King Records
podcast.body: Johnny Otis, a talent scout for King Records, saw The Royals perform with Jackie Wilson and Little Willie John, and King Records decided to sign only The Royals initially, despite Otis's efforts to sign all three acts. "King decided they only wanted to sign the royals, though they would sign Little Willie John a couple of years later."
